Summary
Problem is a challengeor situation that needs to beovercome, in daily life we
assessdifferent situations andaccordinglygenerate appropriate solution.
Problem Solvingdefines theprocess of analysing someparticular situation
andaccordinglybehavinginordertogeneratesomeresponse.
The problem-solving process have two broad categories: problem analysis
andsolutiondevelopment.
Algorithmic Thinking is a problem-solving approach that is useful to
solvetheproblems usingthe computer'sinput-process-outputmodel.
Properties of Algorithmic Thinking: There are four properties that are
Decomposition, Abstraction, Pattern Recognition and Algorithm Design.
Solution Elements are required for solution designing. The basic three
elements are Sequences, Repetition and Condition statements.
Repetition refers to the act of doing any action again and again, this is done by
usingloops. Theloops are oftwotypes: finite and infinite.
Condition Statements are when we need to behave according to the given
situation.
Flow Charts are the graphical representation of the algorithm. Different
specified shapes are used to represent different functions.
